title: Grid Walk — know the area. source ? backscatter. big prey later.

the_plan.now: walk OUR grid. every cell we own. what we put out (source). what comes back (backscatter).
the_plan.not_now: do not chase JP/DE/IN/FR/GB as big game. we do not know the range well enough.
the_plan.later: when the grid is walked and the cairns have a second stone, pick the biggest heading and hunt.

grid.concept: the home range is a grid. each cell is a source we publish from. backscatter is what that cell returns. walking the grid is how we know the area.
